notes: The Connection Type card now fills its width, so Standard, Hysteria2 and WireGuard are all visible. The Gamerz/Streamerz switch is slower and smoother. The Speed dial is a car cluster again: dark face, tick ring, lit arc, tapered needle, five labels and a digital capsule under the hub. The full-width measuring bar and round Stop button remain, as do the whole-card targets and normal refresh cursors. Windows experimental build; the phone stays at 0.7.5.
